display_long_description:
LAX VR is the ultimate first-person VR lacrosse experience, featuring both Box and Field play—including an exhilarating 6v6 field game where you can step in as a field player, long pole, or goalie. Game modes include Field, Box, Braveheart, Shooting, Goalie, Longstick, Shoot Around, and Wall Ball. The Medicine Game honors the Indigenous origins of lacrosse in a mythical historic setting. Hone your skills, customize your twig, and chase a championship in Box or Field 6v6 tournaments.

The newest expansion (IAP) adds full 10v10 field action and a dynamic Coach’s Mode: change middie lines, call timeouts, manage tempo, and even argue with refs. It also introduces a dodging challenge, a box-goalie skills test, and a field-goalie workout designer. This expansion is a separate purchase—consider the bundle for the best value.

Unique touch-controller physics capture the feel of a real stick. With a family-friendly, one-time cost and no hidden fees, you can simply play, compete on global leaderboards, and master every shot. LAX VR delivers a fast, realistic lacrosse experience with deep skill modes and full customization for true lacrosse style.
